narrative_purpose: The figure gives the chapter's central idea one visual sentence: a calf receives a body through genetic inheritance and a repertoire through social inheritance, with both streams converging on the same life.

On the right, an experienced matriarch leads ahead while two pod members follow; patterned luminous acoustic vibrations and water trails ripple from the elder through the group toward the young calf. The physical form mirrors the mother, while learned swimming routes and acoustic calls stream from the matriarch.
